# Tarikur Rahman

## Robotics Inventor & System Architect

Tarikur Rahman is a robotics inventor, systems thinker, and technology researcher based in Bangladesh. He is known for building intelligent robotics systems, tactical defense rover concepts, and IoT-driven automation projects that bridge engineering, design, and real-world problem solving.

He currently works with Team DEMON71 and has contributed to projects spanning robotics prototyping, embedded systems, autonomous platforms, and digital innovation.

## Key Projects
- PHANTOM-X — Tactical defense rover platform focused on robotics innovation and field-based experimentation.
- PHOENIX-F1 — Firefighting rover concept built around safety, automation, and engineering problem solving.
- AETHER-H1 — Global IoT automation project designed for connected systems and intelligent deployment scenarios.
- SHEPHERD-X — Real-time safety tracking and monitoring solution for advanced robotics and field operations.

## Awards
- WICE 2026 Gold Medalist
- 47th National Science Fair Champion

## Summary
Tarikur Rahman combines robotics engineering, systems architecture, and innovation leadership to build intelligent hardware and software experiences. His work centers on autonomous robotics, tactical defense platforms, IoT applications, and future-focused technology development.
